Israeli strikes hit Gaza, destroying medical warehouses

Israeli military strikes in Gaza killed between two and eight people, according to various reports. The strikes targeted five Hamas weapons depots and destroyed medical supply warehouses, including one at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital. Gaza's Health Ministry condemned the strike on medicine stores. Ceasefire hopes were described as hanging by a thread.
